item.title: Porsche’s Wehrlein reigns supreme in Jeddah E-Prix Race 1

item.title: Logano on Daytona 500: ‘Say a prayer. It’s going to be crazy’
item.description: The pair of qualifying races is meant to serve two purposes: to finalize the Daytona 500 field and to give drivers a chance to learn the characteristics of their race cars. The lesson this time around seems to be to get ready to hang on.

item.title: Elliott knows nothing is guaranteed in the Daytona 500
item.description: Chase Elliott's decade of experience in the Daytona 500 has taught him that winning his Thursday night qualifying race has its benefits, but there is still plenty of work to do.
